experiment_title: GridION sequencing: Nanopore targeted mitochondrial Sequencing of GM12878
validation_scope: Engineering integration only; no calibrated allele-frequency or molecular-architecture truth.
selection_policy: First N complete FASTQ records; convenience sample, not random or representative.
full_file_checksum_scope: fastq_md5 applies to the complete upstream gzip file, never to a partial download.
